Dear Arden Brooks,

I am Student 001, an MA Illustration graduate from the University for the Creative Arts. I am exploring practice-led doctoral opportunities for 2027 at Griffith University.

My proposed research connects illustration with material practice, craft & illustration. I would value the chance to discuss whether this direction could fit your supervision and the university's research environment.

I have attached my CV and portfolio, together with a research proposal. Would you be available for a brief conversation about research fit and the next application steps?

Kind regards,
Student 001
